title: Bollinger Band 2-candle reversal grid EA (Advance Trading Robot 17)
entry_long: candle ID2 bearish, candle ID1 bullish, both candle lows below Bollinger Lower Band -> buy next candle
entry_short: candle ID2 bullish, candle ID1 bearish, both candle highs above Bollinger Upper Band -> sell next candle
exit: trailing stop 15 pips step 1 pip on group-of-trades after 2+ orders; no SL/TP on individual orders
buildon_idea: already capped at 20 orders via Max Order; try converting linear-add (L+0.02/step) to log-lot law and add hard SL per leg to cage tail risk
novelty_note: BB extreme + 2-candle confirm entry with dual-mode follow-trend/reverse-trend management; common fxDreema pattern in this series

title: Stochastic overbought/oversold 3-candle-momentum grid EA on XAUUSD M1 (rev.2, dynamic close-money)
entry_long: 3 consecutive bullish candles (ID1<ID2<ID3 shrinking wait: body ID1>ID2>ID3 largest first) + Stochastic < 30 (oversold, adjusted from default 20)
entry_short: 3 consecutive bearish candles with decreasing body size + Stochastic > 70 (overbought, adjusted from default 80)
exit: dynamic close-money = base close_money(3 USD) x (grid trade count / step count) group-close; step counter every 5 legs adds 0.01 lot
escalation_cap: unspecified (no explicit max-order constant shown; step-based lot increase every 5 trades)
buildon_idea: add explicit Max Order cap (not shown in this rev) before live use; dynamic close-money scaling with trade count is a reusable exit-tuning idea to catch on other grid EAs
novelty_note: dynamic/scaling close-money formula (grows with accumulated trade count) instead of fixed $ close is a distinct build-on idea vs other cards in this batch

title: 3-candle momentum expanding-body pattern grid EA with backtest-mode comparison (Control Points vs Every Tick)
entry_long: 3 consecutive bullish candles with increasing body size (ID1>ID2>ID3, largest most recent) -> buy
entry_short: 3 consecutive bearish candles with increasing body size (ID1>ID2>ID3) -> sell
exit: profit target in pips (as_Position) scaling with number of open trades; grid-add on adverse move every 10 pips
escalation_cap: unspecified in this base version; martingale x2 shown added in the improvement segment with EMA(8/18) crossover reversal-confirm filter
buildon_idea: video itself demonstrates the build-on: adding EMA(8,18) crossover confirmation before opening a martingale-doubled correction leg cut Max DD from 85% to 45% and raised profit from 125% to 217% in the same backtest -- validated cheap improvement pattern to reuse on other grid EAs in this batch
novelty_note: video is explicitly a before/after case study of adding a reversal-confirmation filter to reduce grid/martingale DD -- useful reusable technique, not a novel entry signal itself

title: 2-day daily-trend signal + EMA crossover entry with grid correction and equity-percent cut-loss (Advance Trading Robot 19)
timeframe: Daily bias signal, entry TF unspecified (current chart TF)
entry_long: prior 2 daily candles both bullish (close ID1 > high ID2) sets signal_buy=1; then EMA fast crosses above EMA slow on current TF -> buy (once per day)
entry_short: prior 2 daily candles both bearish (close ID1 < low ID2) sets signal_sell=1; then EMA fast crosses below EMA slow -> sell (once per day)
exit: grid correction every 40 pips (fixed 0.1 lot per leg), group-close when floating profit > 10 USD; optional equity Cut-loss Mode at -30% of balance
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed 0.1 lot per leg, no lot escalation shown)
buildon_idea: grid correction uses fixed lot (not martingale) so main build-on is testing Cut-loss Mode always-on (video shows leaving it off risks >30% DD in adverse years like 2023) and widening the daily-trend confirm to more days
novelty_note: daily-bar trend confirmation gating an intraday EMA-cross entry, with once-per-day signal reset via time filter -- distinct low-frequency filter mechanism

title: ZigZag trend regime + RSI divergence entry with dual-mode strategy selection (Advance Trading Robot 20)
entry_long: uptrend regime (price rises to equal ZigZag High) -> mode1: wait for bullish RSI divergence (price makes lower low via ZigZag lows, RSI at ID1-low > RSI at ID0-low) -> buy, trend-lines drawn on price and RSI sub-window for confirmation
entry_short: downtrend regime (price falls to equal ZigZag Low) -> mode2: wait for bearish RSI divergence (price makes higher high via ZigZag highs, RSI at ID1-high < RSI at ID0-high) -> sell
exit: trailing stop 15 pips group-of-trades after 2+ legs; grid-add correction every 40 pips (follow-mode) / 60 pips (reverse-mode) gated by EMA(3,8) crossover + 3-pip separation confirm
escalation_cap: unspecified (L_Plus=0.02 step increments shown, no explicit Max Order cap in this transcript)
buildon_idea: add explicit Max Order cap (not shown); the regime-gated strategy-selection architecture (mode1 vs mode2 by trend direction) is itself a reusable framework to plug in other signals per regime; backtest shown PF 8.51 EURUSD H1 1yr -- worth reproducing on more symbols/years before judging
novelty_note: highest-effort card in this batch: true RSI divergence detection via ZigZag pivot lookback + trend-line drawing on both price and indicator sub-window, plus per-trend-direction strategy switching (mode1/mode2) -- above-average novelty for this fxDreema corpus

title: EMA200 distance + RSI overbought/oversold reversion entry with money-based cut-loss (Advance Trading Robot 21)
entry_long: close ID1 below EMA200 by more than 25 pips AND RSI crosses up through 30 (oversold) -> buy
entry_short: close ID1 above EMA200 by more than 25 pips AND RSI crosses down through 70 (overbought) -> sell
exit: trailing stop 15 pips step5 group-of-trades after 2+ legs; grid-add correction every 40 pips (follow) / 60 pips (reverse, engulfing-confirmed); hard money cut-loss at -500 USD closes everything
escalation_cap: unspecified numeric max-order; -500 USD money-based cut-loss acts as circuit breaker
buildon_idea: already has a money-based cut-loss cage (-500 USD); build-on = replace fixed-dollar cut-loss with %-of-equity (video shows 2023 backtest hit -86% relative DD before cut-loss triggered, meaning -500 was too loose relative to balance growth) and test across more years/symbols
novelty_note: mean-reversion-to-EMA200 with minimum-distance filter (25 pips) combined with RSI extreme crossover -- distance-from-MA as an entry-quality gate is a reusable idea

title: ICT-style 3-candle zone + engulfing entry with follow/reverse-train grid management (Advance Trading Robot 22)
entry_long: 3 bearish candles (ID1-3) with summed body size >= 50 pips define ICT Zone (B1=close ID1, B2=open ID3, drawn as chart lines); price re-enters zone AND bullish engulfing on ID1 -> buy
entry_short: 3 bullish candles (ID1-3) with summed body size >= 50 pips define ICT Zone (S1=close ID1, S2=open ID3); price re-enters zone AND bearish engulfing on ID1 -> sell
exit: trailing stop 40 pips step5 group-of-trades after 2+ legs; grid-add correction every 10 pips (reverse-mode, gated by candlestick reversal pattern) / 40 pips (follow-mode)
buildon_idea: already capped at 20 orders; build-on = test the author-noted parameter discrepancy (grid distance intended as 10 pips but backtest ran at 80 pips) as an explicit sweep axis, since author flags it as unintentional and untested at the designed value
novelty_note: ICT-style supply/demand zone built from summed 3-candle body size with chart object drawing (horizontal lines B1/B2/S1/S2) is a distinctly different zone-construction method vs plain candlestick/indicator entries in this batch

title: Time Bomb Up/Down tick-velocity breakout scalper on XAUUSD M1 with tight fixed SL
entry_long: Time Bomb Up detects price rising 10 pips within 10 seconds -> buy with fixed 60-pip SL on first order
entry_short: Time Bomb Down detects price falling 10 pips within 10 seconds -> sell with fixed 60-pip SL on first order
exit: trailing stop 30 pips step1 (group-of-trades) once 2+ legs open; grid-add every 60 pips in trade's favorable direction
escalation_cap: n/a (fixed 0.01 lot per leg, no lot escalation)
buildon_idea: simplest/cleanest card in batch (fixed lot, real SL, 10-min build time per author) -- good NEVER-TOUCHED candidate to reproduce; extend to more symbols/TFs and test velocity thresholds (10pip/10sec) as sweep axis, and verify Time Bomb block's tick-data dependency doesn't behave differently on live spread
novelty_note: uses FX Dreema's built-in price-velocity (pips-per-second) signal blocks rather than a standard indicator -- distinct entry mechanism; author reports PF backtest 139% profit, 1.16% max DD over 1.75yr XAUUSD M1, modeling quality 99%
